items.title: Joe Wilder Part 2 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 12, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Are you familiar with a fellow named John Frosk? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, Johnny Frosk.

ctx.x: No, not at all. So at least we know where we’re coming from with it.

I usually pretend my saxophone is broken if I can’t think of anything. That’s something that works. I had made a little note about something I read and I wonder if it actually © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -12-
happened. This came out of one of those anecdote books. Are you familiar with a fellow named John Frosk?
